description: The event an engine that cannot wait for a delegate_tasks call sends in place of the call's tool_call and tool_result, and ends its run (agent#14), as the Go agent engine sends it on an agent capability (ADR-0007): the request, and callId, the agent wire's id of the call, which the coordinator keeps in the checkpoint's handoff (delegation/handoff.json). The coordinator consumes the event, so a host reading its stream sees no end after it; the TypeScript codex engine sends no callId. Written by hand from the schema.
